In the summer of 1914, a part of the Tonkin governer's palace were transferred from Hanoi to SaPa for holiday, some of them stayed there til October.  in 1918, Hautefeulle (villa only for civil servants) were constructed by Hong Gai Coal Group and Hai Phong Cement Company.  In 1921, the envoy's palace was built. In the same year, the most superficial palace of the Tonkin Governor was built in SaPa.  In 1924, Fansipan hotel was built right in the heart of the Kinh's village. In June 1929, Mr Michel has proposed building a luxury hotel in SaPa with stone.  In 1932, the largest hotel in SaPa with 45 rooms - Metropole (known as the Grand Hotel De SaPa) was inaugurated.  In 1937, Ernest Jean Chaperon invested in building the Center Hotel. Categories.value: Self-published work|Files with coordinates missing SDC location of creation|Sa Pa Museum

ImageDescription.value: The First Intentions of Sapa Tourism. IndoChina Tourist Map - Wall Poster - SaPa Museum: In the winter of 1903-1904, officers (including Lieutenant Poinat) from the Department of Geographic Indichina took a field trip to Lao Cai to mapping ration: 1/100.000, this work lasted until 1905 with the marked geodetic under the order of the naval officer - Mr Scherdlin.  the firts information on the geography, climate and flora had been collected and SaPa had since then gradually appeared.  At the beginning period, only European soldiers and people of Lao Cai who went to Binh Lu and Phong Tho knew SaPa when they crossed O Qui Ho mountain pass, "the cottages were built and families were used to go by horse to rest in this plateau".  Tourres - French Resident envoy in Lao Cai was the  first to beleive in the possibility of SaPa to become a major resort station.  His first act was to promote this region to the Tonkin Resident envoy to initiate the desire to send the first settler to live in SaPa: Mr. Mievlle, also in 1909, Tourres called for an advertiser, Mr. Hautefeuille who was responsible to attract the Press's attention to SaPa.  To develop SaPa, Tourres placed SaPa in the overall programs of Indochina tourism development.

pages.title: File:2017 11 19 102322 Vietnam SaPa Museum history.jpg

Categories.value: Self-published work|Files with coordinates missing SDC location of creation|Sa Pa Museum

ImageDescription.value: - Wall Poster - SaPa Museum: In the feudal time, saPa was in Thuy Vy prefecture, Quy Hoa district, Hung Hoa province. In Minh Mang dynasty (the Nguyen), Thuy Vy prefecture was divided into several Tong communes, SaPa became Tong Huong Vinh, including 15 villages.  In winter 1903, the expedition by the Department of Geography Indochina, while conducting survey mapping ratio 1/100.000, they discovered the plataeu landscape and high land named Lo Suoi Tung and SaPa village located at the beginning of Ngoi Dum stream.  The expedition named the high land - Cao Tram SaPa.  This event was the foundation and development of SaPa.  After the establishment of Lao Cai province (July 12th 1907) SaPa region included 2 communes: Binh Lu and Huong Vinh.  in the 1930s, SaPa was changed into a district including 37 villages and one town with 1020 families.  On March 9th 1944 SaPa was established including: Murong Hoa, Hurong Vinh village and one town called Xuan Vien (SaPa town today).  In 1948, saPa was devided into 3 communes: saPa Chung, Muong Bo, Kim Hoa (it was also called Mong Va).  In 1976, the merger of Hoang Lien Son province from 3 provinces of Lao Cai, yen Bai and Nghia Lo, SaPa became a district of Hoang Lien Son province.  After Lao Cai was re-established in 1991, saPa became a district of Lao Cai province.  It is now known as a famous tourists destination in Vietnam and in the world
